name: Login announces the released Heroic and Mythic dungeon events
contract: The client offers Random Classic Dungeon Heroic (1258) and Mythic (2258) only while one of their game events is active (C_LFG.RequiresGameEvent), otherwise it reports the difficulty as not released. Each login sends one active SMSG_GAME_EVENT_INFO (0x09BD) for every Heroic event (394, 395, 396, 436, 437, 447) and every Mythic event (728 to 732, 734). This checks the packets the server builds for a socketless session, not the client's rendering of the Dungeon Finder.
